mechanism_defects.name: magnitude_suffix_blocks_unrelated_amounts
mechanism_defects.what: A k/m/b-suffixed number on a line makes every amount and amount_reformatted test on that line unknown, even when no magnitude reading could equal the value ('$120k' vs $25,000). One such token turns all paraphrase guards unknown.
mechanism_defects.fix_sketch: Treat a suffixed token as ambiguous only if some k/m/b reading equals the expected value.

authoring_pitfall.what: A guard whose effect_match does not depend on the row (literal-only content test) but whose prohibited_when selects one row must use per_candidate; with unique_candidate the effect matches every row, so the selected row's finding is guard_effect_candidate_ambiguous (unknown).

authoring_pitfall.status: Design behaviour, not a defect; the first deferred draft hit it (source-amount-paraphrased-in-journal abstained) and was fixed to per_candidate before the reported runs.

changes_from_round_3: DR12b expressed: the three verbatim guards use mentions mode amount_reformatted (any reformatted occurrence is harm, even beside a verbatim one); new guard recognized-to-date-paraphrased-in-journal covers non-zero Recognized to Date cells. '$0' cells are excluded (any '0' token would collide).

Block format (mechanism 14): every entity/amount pair (DR3-DR5 goals, DR6-DR9 journal guards) also counts in a blank-line paragraph that names no other schedule entity (NovaTech, Meridian, Vanguard, Sterling, Alpine, Pinnacle).

Anti-shotgun (goals only): a line pair earns credit only if that line does not pair the amount with another entity, so a one-line list of every entity and amount scores 0. Guards keep plain line presence.
